Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CVX.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.93 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 170 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
We delivered record revenue of $34.2 billion this quarter, representing 16% year-over-year growth.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 16% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Revenue guidance of $34.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
